surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey median normalized pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency, fine-grained dark-pixel clusters distributed across the central and lateral dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between localized dark pigmented clusters and the slate-grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single prominent, dark elliptical contrast disruption situated on the anterior dorsal midline posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant dark elliptical mark located on the upper dorsal axis.
